annotations.title: Start a Chorus book for a person, and get the one link to forward.

description: Starts a book of voice, video and written messages for one person, and returns the single link the organiser sends to everyone taking part. Gathering is free and the people recording need no app and no account. Use this as soon as somebody wants to collect messages from a group for one person, whether or not there is an occasion. The first call emails the organiser an eight digit code and makes nothing. Call it again with the same details and the code, and the book is made in their account.

answer_with.description: Any of voice, video and written. Voice and written when not said.

closes_on.description: The day collecting stops, as 2026-11-14. Allow three weeks before the day if a printed copy is wanted.

code.description: The eight digit code emailed to the organiser. Leave it out on the first call to have one sent.

expecting.description: Who is expected to record, by name or role, so book_status can say who is still out. Never email addresses.

lead_with.description: Which of those is the big button on a contributor’s phone.

occasion.description: A big birthday, A wedding, A new baby, As they grow, In memory, or Something else. Plain words are matched to one of those.

organiser_email.description: The organiser’s email. The book belongs to this address and they get in with an eight digit code.

questions.description: Questions to ask, if the organiser wants their own. The set for the occasion is used when this is left out.

subject_name.description: Who the book is for, as the organiser says it, for example Mum.

name: start_book
